reviews.text: I have been coming to The Cat Clinic for over 20 years. They have looked after five different cats in my extended family. All the doctors have consistently been excellent, caring and compassionate. The staff friendly, gentle and efficient.
I love this place! The staff and quality of care were unmatched. I highly recommend them and will continue to come back.
Dr Tibbs is the best
I took a t n r cat in to be fixed. I trapped her they took her in the next day fixed her and boarded her for me for two days.

I have come to The Cat Vet for a few years now for the care of my cats. They've been by my side from everything from annual visits to serious illnesses to help with making end of life decisions. I've worked mainly with Dr. Naga (sp) and Dr. Gibbs, but everyone in the practice have been friendly, compassionate, and professional. I wouldn't take my babies any place else!
Front desk team very welcoming, quick acknowledgment.. Vet was very knowledgeable and quick to diagnose and treat my puddy.
This is the first time I visited Cat Vet Clinic and was impressed by their care, kindness and professionalism. If you are looking for a good Cat Vet, I highly recommend them.
Excellent medical care and client service in a serene environment.
Bob appreciated there being NO dogs here. Only had a quick physical exam today but everybody was nice & helpful.

I absolutely love Cat Veterinary Clinic. My animals are always treated with dignity and respect and there has never been any unnecessary test upcharges. The staff is kind and caring, and the doctors are compassionate and truly love their patients. Even when money was tight, they would offer alternatives that could help me and my pets.

There were lots of vet options to go with, but I ended up coming here since I heard they specialize and see only cats. I’ve worked so far with Dr. Wilkins and she has been amazing. My cat, Lumi, is my very first ever cat and pet other than fish. I had tons of questions during our first visit and Dr. Wilkins was so patient in answering all of them. Lumi also got her tooth pulled with other treatments, and the entire process went smoothly. So far loving the team here and appreciate the care they had for Lumi!

I’ve been taking my cat here for 8 years, and I couldn’t recommend them more. He can be very anxious at the vet, but having a cat-specific clinic makes such a difference. The environment is calm, and the staff are incredibly patient and gentle with him. They really take the time to listen and work with his individual personality and behaviors to make each visit as stress-free as possible.

I recently had to take him to an emergency vet after hours, they were notified and actually called to check on him afterward. It’s clear that they genuinely care about their patients and their owners.

We were seen quickly. Dr. Nava was nice and thorough. The experience was good for the owner. I'm not sure the cat would say the same but she can't talk so there's that.

On another appointment we were again seen quickly. Because it was only grooming, the actual appointment didn't take long. Thanks CVC for being great to cats and their owners.
I love this place. They take great care of our cats. The staff (including doctors) are quite good. Parking is easy and free. Warning, cats must be brought in cat carriers.

Dr Filip is above and Beyond the best! I feel so bad that I cannot remember vet technician that helped him, but he was AMAZING as well. I have an older cat with some health issues and had to get labs asap- The situation was dire and extremely concerning so I was not thinking clearly.

They both were so kind, understanding,  they listened, and GENUINELY CARE!! Dr Filip called me immediately when the test results were ready the next NIGHT!  Thank you both for helping me through a scary time.

Expensive but definitely worth it. Dr. Phillips was great to work with. They answered all our questions and were very efficient. They gave me a call the day after to follow up and give me the blood results for my cat.

I love this place so much! Dr Christensen has been seeing my cats and they love her. She is truly so helpful and takes the time to talk to you and figure out what’s wrong with your kitties. Dr Filip is also very helpful! They’re always willing to help out any way they can and to brainstorm ways to solve your issues. I can tell they genuinely love and have cats. I will continue bringing my cats here, I highly recommend this place. There’s hardly ever any wait, and the staff is friendly.

Cat Veterinary Clinic is a fantastic place to receive specialized cat-exclusive care. The clinic staff are friendly, the veterinarians are knowledgeable and I know my babies receive care from professionals who only really spend their careers focusing on cats. Dr Filip is the best, he provides thoughtful answers and delivers bad news directly but with great care. The best place in Houston for one’s feline.

I'm always happy with the service we receive at the clinic, but I have to give a special shout out to Dr. Tibbs. She is patient, calm, and explains everything clearly even when I'm 10 questions deep. So glad we have a great vet in the neighbourhood!

Dr. Filip and team took great care in examining my feline for her annual exam two years in a row. He prescribed Bonqat to help her feel more relaxed. I brought my cat in to see Dr. Nava too. Great and caring team of vets and vet techs.
Love the detailed care and attention from the staff at this cats only vet!
They are so friendly with the humans and gentle with the kitties!
They’re not the closest to me or the cheapest,  but they’ve taken care of all of our cats over the decades. Smart, efficient, feline focused. They know their cats, er, stuff.
We had a great experience at the Cat Veterinary Clinic. Dr. Filip and staff were very kind and too the time to answer all of our questions.
Always a great experience at the Cat Vet.

I (and at least seven of my cats) have been regulars at the Cat Vet Clinic.  They have walked me through almost everything I can imagine. Completely trust the Doctors and the Vet Tech staff is so amazing and caring.  Highly recommend Cat Vet Clinic.

Overall, my experience was excellent. The front desk staff was incredibly accommodating after I made a scheduling mistake. They were able to work us into the schedule with only a minimal wait, which I greatly appreciated.

The veterinary technician was pleasant, though her handling technique could be improved. She immediately scruffed my cat to remove him from the carrier, and I would have preferred a gentler, lower-stress approach. Also, she definitely seemed to be taking out some frustration on the keyboard!

Dr. Christensen was outstanding. She took the time to understand my cat's complicated medical history, explained her assessment in a way that was easy to understand, and made me feel confident in the plan moving forward. She developed a straightforward treatment plan and made me feel heard throughout the visit.

This was my older cat’s 3rd vet after his longtime veterinarian retired.  Hit!  All the vets are great, they have weekend hours, support staff is outstanding.  They have heart, and know cats like nobody’s business!  I’m very grateful for them, and sticking like glue to this clinic!
This Vet really cares about her patients

My cat had a dental cleaning with extractions and I can say that everything went well! She is 12 years old and I was scared of the anesthesia. I am very grateful that Dr Nava had the time to call me to explained me and help me when I was very concerned about the extractions. The price is a little high but it’s worth it. I’ll bring all my cats here! :)

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this clinic. The issue was never the refund itself; it was the complete lack of communication and poor customer service.

I requested a refund and sent three emails before receiving a response. After being ignored, my husband and I drove to the clinic to speak with the office manager, only to be told she wasn't available. We then called and specifically asked to speak with her, but she still would not come to the phone. Instead, the receptionist spoke on her behalf.

What made the situation even more frustrating is that I later learned my refund had already been processed before we called that day. Instead of simply telling us that, the receptionist said she was "having her do it right now," making it seem as though nothing had been done. When we asked for a confirmation email, we felt rushed off the phone without receiving a clear answer.

If someone had simply communicated that the refund had already been processed and would take a few business days to appear on my credit card, this entire situation could have been avoided. Instead, we were left feeling ignored and forced to repeatedly follow up just to get basic information.

I also encourage future clients to carefully review their invoice before leaving the office. In my experience, my deposit was not deducted from my final balance at the time of payment as I was told it would be, which resulted in me having to request a refund afterward. Double-check your charges before paying to avoid the same situation.

I hope the clinic improves its billing communication and customer service so future patients don't have a similar experience.
For many years, I've taken my kitties to Cat Veterinary Clinic.  The vets great and they don't push services on clients.

Dr. Tibbs knows our cat well enough to know he wasn't feeling well and took the time to figure out what the issue could be. I feel comfortable with the diagnosis and treatment plan going forward and know we can reach out at anytime, which is very comforting. Will continue to take Calvin to CVC for the best care available!
My family loves the care this clinic provides, especially with Dr. Tibbs!
Caring and kind care for our elderly cat.  Our veterinarian was caring and helpful as she outlined care options.
My appointment was with Dr. Christensen and she gave my cat a very thorough exam.  Really liked her and will ask for her in the future.
Responsive vet, very helpful and good followup
The veterinarian Dr. Philip and staff are always caring, thorough and wonderful with our cats!

I absolutely recommend Cat Veterinary Clinic to anyone that wants the best care for their feline family members. All of the staff are friendly and professional, and I feel confident that my cat is in good hands there. The veterinarians do a great job of communicating, and they value your input as the pet parent to come up with the best plan for your kitty's health.
We love Dr. Tibbs and have been going to her since 2015. She has always been professional yet joyful. Listens closely to our concerns and always looks at the big picture when it comes to treatment.
I have been a customer for over 10 years.  The staff is amazing and I always know my cats are getting the best care possible.  They really care.
Cat Veterinary Clinic has cared for my cats, plus a few strays along the way, since 2017.  The doctors and staff are great and have consistently provided the best care. I wouldn't go anywhere else.
My first experience here was amazing! The technician Kendra, and Dr. Christensen were so sweet, helpful, and amazing! My kitty was completely calm the entire time. 💓 …
My cat vet for life!  I have trusted and received superior care from the entire team for over 15 years. Highly recommended.
Kind staff, reasonable prices, and a wonderful experience each time. I cannot recommend them enough, they always take of my cat when I bring her in.
Good vets. Well organized. Short wait.
The best vet.
We always love our visits here over the last seven years! Everyone is so kind and efficient when it comes to seeing our 3 cats. Highly recommend!
Very nice to our son Lucifer. Professional and knowledgeable.

I’ve been a loyal client for over twelve years, and I can’t imagine going anywhere else.  I drive over 30 miles to the Cat Vet Clinic because they are the experts, consummate  professionals, and refreshingly compassionate.  I had an issue crop up with one of my cats, and Dr. Philip called me quickly to acknowledge my concerns.  He fit me and kitty into his schedule the next day.  I’m grateful for his expertise and concern. The whole staff is wonderful and completely capable, knowledgeable and caring.  Infinite gratitude!!!!

So happy that I found this clinic. My kitties are in very good hands. One of my kitties was very sick and Dr Nava assessed the problem quickly and began treatment immediately. My thanks to a wonderful staff who are always very responsive.
Great visit with Dr. Filip. Would strongly recommend taking cats to him.
I am so grateful I change vet and found Dr Nava  Who has helped my elderly cat that has inflammatory bowel disease

As always a great experience at The Cat Vet Clinic. They were sweet and gentle with my tom cat. Got a correct diagnosis and meds and sent on our way. Staff is incredibly kind and friendly and knowledgeable.

Great service and expertise! My cat had a dental exam and they did a great job to prepare her for the procedure. I received a phone call when she was in recovery and Dr. Filip thoroughly explained all the findings and what to watch out for when she came home. Highly recommend!
Great with our 2 cats!
Excellent care and service. I won’t take my cat anywhere else, if I can avoid it. ❤️
Very loving and thorough

I’ve never been to a cat only clinic, but I wish I had sooner! Dr. Philips did a great job at taking a look at my senior cat. He gave great recommendations to get my cat healthy. The staff were also phenomenal. Happy I’d found my forever vet!

As someone who moved from a small town where I was used the same veterinarian that my family had used for 20+ years, I was super hesitant when it came to searching for a new vet for my cat (especially because cats, including mine, are notoriously rude patients).  Getting him scheduled at the Cat Vet clinic was so easy and I felt so safe with his care there.  He was rude (as expected), but the vet and vet techs/staff were great in handling him! Highly recommend for your cats!
Thank you to The Cat Clinic Team and Dr. Nancy C for saving my cat Louie and helping Lucy live her best life. ❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹🐱🐱🐱🐱

Dr. Wilkins and the staff did a great job with Grayson.  I was relieved and grateful that they were able to work him into their schedule on Friday.  He is an outside, partially feral cat that I wasn't sure we would be able to catch again.
We’ve brought our cat here for several years.  They are so nice.  Reasonable.  Great prices.  Great care.  Highly recommend if you have cats!!  We always enjoy visiting.
I’ve been going to The Cat Vet since the 1990s. I’ve always felt that my cat was safe with the cat vets there. They always take the time to explain things well to me and address all my questions.

We chose this place because of the reviews along with it being only a cat clinic. We've been coming here for about 3yrs and we love the staff. They are all friendly and have been taking good care of our babies. I like how they ask for videos if we have a question about something and they get back to us same day. I appreciate all of them. Thank you for taking great care of all our fur babies
babies

Dr. Filip was able to perform a difficult spay on a cat that had been adopted from an animal shelter. The spay from the shelter was incomplete and it was as if she was  in heat frequently. We think that is the reason whoever adopted her from the shelter let her go. We were so grateful he was able to help her. It really helped us! Dr. Filip helped us with a little kitten who had been left by her mother. We were bottle feeding her and he gave her a checkup. He was able to tell us she was a female kitten even at young age. Our prior veterinarian in San Antonio removed a 6 month old male cat’s stomach thinking he was a female. He died overnight. We are so impressed with Dr. Filip- he really came through for us.
Cowboy (a stray) got fixed, shots and a check up. They took great care of him and gave him some love.

I cancelled the appointment before the 24 hr mark and was told the deposit refund would be processed by their manager. Even after cancelling the first time, I still got an email reminder about the appointment. I called the next morning and spoke with Lydia to confirm the cancellation. She said the appointment was never properly cancelled but that she will try cancelling again and let her manager know about issuing the deposit refund. Still no news on the refund so I called the 3rd time. Lydia said she will see if the manager can refund by the end of day. I STILL have not gotten the deposit back. They don’t properly cancel the appointments and don’t honor their policy of refunding the deposit if cancelled before 24 hrs. Either they are very disorganized or just simply want your money…
Cat exam, ravbies vax.,nails trimmed.

Dr Matthew Fillip is awesome. On our first visit he spent a lot of time with us getting to know us and our beloved cats, explained everything clearly, listened - and heard! - our questions and concerns. Very practical and helpful. Example: our male cat had a minor urinary problem and Dr Filip advised what to do in a very practical and informative way. AND both of our cats were calm and very comfortable with him! We all had a great experience!

I love this vet clinic! They’re welcoming, nice, and knowledgeable. Dr Christensen is the best. I have full trust and confidence in her to take the best care of my cat. Couldn’t recommend this place more!

We had a bad experience with this vet and di d not even make it through the door. We were looking for a vet to help us prep our cats and their paperwork for a move. We asked if they provided those services and it was confirmed so we scheduled an initial  appt. Someone called us ahead of the appointment to ask questions about where we were moving and stated , they would "rather be at home right now with my wife and kids (something to this effect) rather than researching laws for other countries" for us. We didnt ask them to do any research ahead of time and were making our own checklist to help guide the process.  Our appointment was still about a week away. We then were charged around $250 and have no idea why. We called and were able to get the charge reversed but they could not explain what the charge was ans why it happened when it did. We canceled the appointment right after that

For 25+ years my cat family have been patients at Cat Vet Clinic and Dr. Nancy Christensen and Dr. Matthew Filip.  I think of Dr. Nancy as a Pediatrician to my fur babies. From the front desk to all the techs, we have always been shown care and compassion .  I especially like the fact they treat only cats so you don’t go into a waiting room full of barking dogs.

The staff is very thorough and thoughtful when treating “Baby” and they always seem to know what’s best for her regarding treatment.  She’s a very large female and I know she is a handful!  Thanks for being so patient with her!

I trust the expertise and gentle care provided by the vets and techs at the Cat Veterinary Clinic.  Dexter needed dental surgery and he is doing well two days later.  They called today to check on him … and to put me at ease.  I love the Cat Veterinary Clinic.

This was for a visit in 2025: Dr. Filip was very patient with Mac and made certain to discuss any questions or concerns I had. Not only did Mac get great care, I felt thoroughly satisfied with his recommendations and attention to detail. We have had excellent care from all vets we've seen at Cat Veterinary Clinic and highly recommend them.

I highly recommend it. Every doctor is incredibly kind, attentive, and takes the time to explain everything in a clear, detailed, and personalized way. Their expertise with cats truly stands out, and you can feel how much they genuinely care. They treat every feline patient with so much love, patience, and dedication—it really gives you peace of mind knowing your little one is in such good hands!
Excellent care for my boy Bear-as usual!  Everyone very helpful and Dr. Felipe is the best!  Thank you
They take great care of.my elderly cat. Doctors are knowledgeable and compassionate.

Cat vet clinic is the best experience that I’ve had with veterinary care. I am incredibly grateful for the care and attention the staff gives to all levels of care - be it surgical attention, or just regular check ups. Could not recommend more highly.
We love the cat clinic. The team is so friendly and caring. I love being able to take our cat to a clinic that is specifically for cats!

i adopted a shelter cat a month ago and wanted to get her established with a clinic. I found Cat Vet Clinic and loved the fact that they are a cat only clinic. Dr Filip was amazing. The entire staff was so welcoming and made my cat Olivia and myself feel so comfortable. Dr Filip explained her past history and really showed care and compassion. I drove 11/2 hours to get there and passed many Vet's on the way. I am so happy I did. Side note Olivia loved the treats!!!!!!!

Love this place! My cats are indoor only and got their first shots and spaying done here in 2021, but I hadn't been back until this year and expected some shaming, tbh -- none! They were super cool with my introverted scaredy cat babies and understanding about the delay and its reasonings.

The staff knows their cats! They were able to handle my girls smoothly, kept us informed at every step, offered options for treatment (not just directives) -- 10/10 won't take my girls anywhere else. Thanks, CVC!

I’ve been using this clinic for over 20 years, and the doctors are very knowledgeable and skilled. However, since the practice has grown and expanded its patient base, the customer service has declined. Unfortunately, it no longer has the same caring, personal feel it once did.

Really great doctors (esp Dr. Christensen and Dr. Wilkens) and helped me greatly to nurse my kittens back to health.  They are doing great now but had a lot of issues in the beginning.  Would highly recommend!

Great experience :
Easy to make an appt that matched my scheduling needs
Dr was on time
Dr explained issue in layman’s terms
Options to address along with timeline/cost estimate

Bravo
Staff is always very kind and thoughtful during any type of appt that we might have.  They have helped us with TNR and with a few strays that we foster and find homes for. Such a great staff!
I appreciate the care and attention of Dr. Christensen and the staff.

I felt like they really cared about my
cat.

I had my first visit with the clinic. I was super impressed. Dr. Christensen took a lot of time with me and my cat, giving me tips on how to stop some behaviors. She explained everything very thoroughly and also gave me estimates for a procedure that needs done. My cat is super challenging and I was expecting to have to have him sedated but they were able to manage him and his behaviors to get him seeing. The atmosphere was great for my cat. I will definitely be back.
Dr. Filip is wonderful! He is thorough and answers questions in a friendly way. He also does not recommend pricey and unnecessary procedures like prior vets I have been to.

Thank you for the review, Jeff!

The Team at Cat Veterinary Clinic
If you are a cat parent and wants a clinic that specializes in cats then look no further- Dr. Filip is my vet of choice

Dr Filip was fantastic and spent a good deal of time explaining what could be the problem with our cat. We really appreciated his recommendation and to avoid drugs when the solution could be very simple.
Always great care
I’ve been taking my cats to this clinic for over 30 years. They’re A great team of vets and techs. They were  so professional and caring with our frightened cat.

Def recommend.  My cat is normally very skittish but they handled her so well so she was chill.  Dr Amber Nava and her team did an amazing job and walked me through everything and even helped me catch her high “kitty blood pressure” (my words lol) so we can address that before it becomes a real problem

We bring all our cats here (inside and our outside colony)....Top notch diagnosis's, clean and friendly service! Not inexpensive but we have confidence in them AND they do inform us about less expensive places for meds, etc!
The staff are all so friendly and helpful. Dr Filip takes the time and care to explain everything.

I’ve been taking my cats to the Cat Vet Clinic for many years, and they have always taken great care of my kitties. They are really caring and compassionate, and when I was really worried on a Saturday morning about my older kitty with kidney problems who was vomiting a lot and off her food, Dr. Nava agreed to work her in. I am so grateful. They took great care of her and were able to diagnose her and prescribe a plan and answered all my questions. Dr. Tibbs has been their usual vet but wasn’t working that day and she has been amazing with our cats. Dr. Nava was great with our sick little girl at that visit and afterwards. The staff and the vets are really kind and really care. I highly recommend this practice!!
Dr. Nava was such a gem!! She really cares about animals and was so knowledgeable. 10/10.
CVC always treats my cats with attention and love. Appreciate their expertise very much.

I love cat clinic, they have always been efficient, knowlegeable, and effective with their care for my animals. I cannot recommend them enough, after having no success from neighborhood vet clinics who only drained my wallet.

Wonderful veterinary clinic for cats! My cats have been treated here for 5+ years and have always received consistent treatment. The techs and doctors are all very gentle and appreciate cats for their natural demeanor. We’ve had health issues caught early by attentive care here, as well as received quality care for larger procedures. I would recommend this clinic to any cat owner.

Three different trips, three wrong diagnosis, and it should’ve been seen very simple. On our third trip we suggested what it was. They then very reluctantly performed a test and we were right. Unfortunately, the cat was subjected to unnecessary counter productive treatment prior to that.  I think the clinic needs to find new leadership to help train.
Very caring and knowledgeable

My sweet girl Gracie is an adorable, chunky, yet absolutely terrified and feisty little fur baby who has found herself battling chronic UTI’s. The vet office I was taking her to would prescribe meds and even try to collect a urine sample but they were unable to do so because she would just not cooperate. Well, after plenty of research I landed at this wonderful clinic and managed to secure a next day booking. The front office staff was so kind, patient, answered my million questions, and calmed my nerves enough that I finally brought Gracie in. The doctor & assistant she saw were able to do the impossible and actually make progress on her condition, something we’ve battled with for three years. I was astonished! We brought her back the very next day for an ultrasound and for the first time ever, I finally feel like we have a plan. We have progress. The doctors/staff kept me informed on pricing before making any moves, gave me plenty of treatment options, and treated my hissing howling sweetheart with such grace. This was also her first time being sedated and they walked me through everything to expect, she recovered perfectly. My baby saw 2-3 different doctors here and I would trust each of them, to care and treat and do what’s best for my baby. I’ve finally found Gracie’s forever clinic!! PS - they have the cutest office cat named Otis who is available for adoption - he’s so playful cuddly.

My 10-yr old cat, Playa, received an exam by Dr. Filip on 01/02/26 as a follow up to her anti-seizure medicine prescribed in Nov 2025 by Dr. Nava. That went well and Playa has done with the meds as prescribed.  Upon further examination, Dr. Filip also advised extraction of 2 of Playa’s teeth.  On 01/06/26, I took Playa to the Cat Veterinary Clinic (CVC) for symptoms of UTI.  She was diagnosed by Dr. Nancy Christensen and was prescribed meds that have alleviated that condition. All 3 doctors that Playa has seen at the CVC have been excellent - professional, compassionate, friendly and willing to take time with Playa and with explaining things clearly to me.

Dr. Wilkens is amazing! Our kitten was having terrible diarrhea and was very sick. Dr. Wilkens was very patient and effective in helping to develop a treatment plan for the kitten and help him get back on track. She followed up multiple times with us over the phone and took true care for him through the hard time. See before and after below.
The Doc and all staff were professional and courteous.  My cat was treated with care and kindness.

Review of 2026 February 26th - Dental Cleaning:
Dr. Filip did an excellent job. 👏🏿 He was very professional and pleasant to speak to. He called after performing Calliope's cleaning to let me know things went well and to discuss her after care. Calliope recovered without no issues and was back to herself the next morning.  Also, the front desk and office staff are friendly and efficient.  I highly recommend the Cat Vet Clinic great service and prices. Most importantly they know what they're doing and they really care about their patients.

Review of 2025 November 21st - Initial Vist/Annual Exam and Vaccinations:
The office was easy to find and had sufficient parking. The front desk staff were professional,  prompt, and courteous. Dr. Christensen and the veterinarian tech Carmen were excellent! They took their time assessing my cat Calliope and they patiently answered all of my questions. I highly recommend this practice.
Very knowledgeable vet! Dr. Wilkens answered so many of my questions about my cat that I was not able to get at other clinics. I am so grateful to have gone to this vet!
Very kind and knowledgeable.

I have been pleased with the service and interaction I have had with catvetclinic and Dr Nala. I’m taking another of my kittos to Dr Tibbs in September and hope it’s also a good experience as well. It is difficult to find a vet that checks all the boxes in working with me, but after a few visits, I feel like I can trust advice and course of action for my fur gang. I will say it takes a bit of time to schedule an appointment,  but it tells me they give sufficient time to each client and they are well respected in community so I just plan a few weeks out when it’s time for vaccinations and it works well
This is the best place to take your cat. Our cat received an extremely thorough examination. Will continue to use your facility. Couldn’t ask for a better veterinarian.

They have taken incredible care of my kitty for several years. Friendly, accommodating, knowledgeable, and trustworthy. The best cat clinic in the city as far as I’m concerned! I’m moving out of state and hope I can find a clinic that I’m able to trust as much as this one.
Everyone is so nice and professional. Love the techs and LOVE Dr. NAVA!!!! She really does give all of our cats the best love and attention!
I love CVC staff so much. They take amazing care of my feline best friends and for that I am forever grateful.
Great service, great expertise! I love that they only cater to cats. It helps minimize stress in the waiting area that there are only feline patients.

I’ve taken our cats to Cat Vet Clinic for years and we are very pleased with their service, expertise and compassion. All the vets are highly knowledgeable and truly care about their patients. Most recently I had a cat with an abdominal issue and Dr. Filip didn’t rush us into doing expensive tests - he thoroughly walked us through the possible causes and laid out a clear approach that started with the least invasive, least expensive treatment, only suggesting the more expensive course of action after other treatments didn’t give us the answers we wanted. The prices aren’t cheap but they’re reasonable for the care and expertise your cat will receive. Highly recommend.
Saved my cat’s life after being inadequately treated at another cat vet. Dr. Christianson and her team are excellent in every way. The staff is always helpful.

Update: I think we have seen all the vets at CVC now, and they are all great. They continue to be easy to schedule with, friendly, and so sweet with our cats. Dr. Nava, Sonya, and Jessica were so good with our cat who is under the weather and really did not want to be at the vet. I'm glad we have access to such a great cat clinic!

We love the Cat Vet Clinic so far! We've seen Dr. Tibbs and Dr. Christensen for new pet exams/vaccines, and both doctors and the techs were great. They took their time to listen and answer all of our many questions, made recommendations on all kinds of things from food to behavior, and didn't rush us. Everyone we interacted with was friendly and loving to us and our cats. They have evening and weekend hours, which makes things really convenient.

Our family has been coming to The Cat Vet for many years, and Dr. Filip has been treating our cats throughout that time with exceptional skill, consistency, and compassion.

He cared for Tonka through serious cardiac issues, guided us through difficult decisions with clarity, and treated him with dignity until the very end.

It is evident that Dr. Filip genuinely cares about his patients, and his expertise is invaluable. He takes the time to explain options clearly, answers questions thoroughly, and treats our cats and our family with respect and kindness. We hold him in the highest regard and are grateful to have such a dedicated veterinarian on our team.

Everyone is very knowledgeable and patient. I came in with my kitty who had an accident on the way over. She was cleaned up and given fresh pad for her kennel. I love that cat only places exist for us humans and cats who prefer this environment. Dr Tibbs took time to answer all of my questions and at no point did I feel rushed. Also, they keep weekend hours which is a huge plus.
The doctors here really listen and help you make the best decision for your animal friend. Love the staff very compassionate and knowledgeable. Would recommend 100%.
Amazing, professional, and knowledgeable service.

This was one of the best vet experiences I’ve ever had. Dr. Meghan Tibbs was kind, patient and knowledgeable. I am a first time cat owner and went in for a wellness visit. Dr. Tibbs was so helpful in answering all of my questions and concerns. She was gentle with my cat and was even aware of his body language when she could tell he was anxious. Pros
•	Easy to schedule appointments
•	On-site ultrasound
•	Cat-only practice
Cons

•	$$$$
•	 My 12-year-old cat was followed at this clinic for almost a year for chronic kidney disease (CKD). He had already been diagnosed for about a year and a half before transferring care. During this time, he began losing weight and eating poorly.

Our initial visit was with Dr. Tibbs, who was knowledgeable and professional, but unfortunately very difficult to schedule with. I later saw Dr. Christensen, and from the first visit I experienced a lack of professionalism. When I requested a basic routine blood pressure monitoring, which is standard in CKD management and common practice in other countries—I later overheard her telling a technician that I was “too much.” I found this inappropriate and dismissive.

I also encountered resistance when requesting a prescription for the renal diet my cat had been eating since diagnosis. Dr. Christensen openly stated she does not agree with prescription diets and reacted dismissively to my request. I was able to get the prescription after the third time requesting. While I understand that nutrition should be individualized and that eating anything is sometimes the priority, that was not the case for my cat—he willingly ate and did well on the renal diet. As someone with a strong background in science, I expect evidence-based explanations when recommendations differ from established guidelines.

More concerning was the management of suspected pyelonephritis. The clinic repeatedly used cefovecin (Convenia) despite lack of improvement. After three injections, I requested a change in therapy. Fluoroquinolones were appropriately avoided due to CKD risk, but the alternative prescribed was amoxicillin alone, without clavulanate. From a pharmacology standpoint, this is often inadequate for upper urinary tract infections, as many causative organisms produce beta-lactamase. This raised serious concerns about clinical judgment.

Additionally, my cat underwent two ultrasounds at this clinic. During the first, he remained at the clinic the entire day and was returned in the afternoon without being fed, despite requiring syringe feeding at the time. Including fasting and clinic time, he went approximately 17 hours without food. No sedation plan was discussed beforehand, and I later learned he had received dexmedetomidine, which is not ideal for CKD patients due to risks of hypotension and reduced renal perfusion. I had assumed minimal or no sedation (such as gabapentin), as my cat had undergone routine ultrasounds without sedation previously.

For the second ultrasound, I refused sedation. Unfortunately, the appointment was delayed, and I had to leave for work before it was performed. Again, my cat went nearly 17 hours without food. When he returned home, he immediately ate an entire can of food and dry food, clearly very hungry.

Since transferring care to a board-certified internal medicine specialist, my cat’s condition has significantly improved—his CKD improved from stage 4 to stage 2 with appropriate management.

Recently, a caregiver accidentally scheduled an appointment at this clinic due to its name appearing on old medication bottles. I received an email canceling the appointment, stating dissatisfaction with care. While I had no intention of returning, I found it concerning that expressing disagreement with medical decisions resulted in dismissal rather than discussion.

Recommendations

This clinic may be suitable for routine care, vaccinations, or basic preventative services. However, for chronic or complex medical conditions, I strongly recommend seeking care from a veterinary internal medicine specialist, where critical thinking, evidence-based decision-making, and collaborative communication are essential.
